g.title: n2
g.text: a restaurant for one day: parties arrive, wait, eat and leave, one mesh run per minute

g.title: n4
g.text: the front door: parties of guests arrive, more at lunch and dinner

g.title: n8
g.text: the wall clock: one tick per mesh run, carrying the minute of the day

g.title: n12
g.text: the host seats parties first come, first served at the first table where they fit

g.title: n26
g.text: the bookkeeper: counts served and lost parties, waiting time and revenue

g.title: n79
g.text: the queue at the door: parties wait for a table or give up
